ここをタップして接続します。USB（ケーブル）またはBluetooth（端末一覧）を選びます。Bluetoothや付近の端末の許可を求められたら許可してください。接続すると、アイコンが接続状態になり、アクセント色で強調表示されます。

Sends a real modifier-down to the connected device when you long-press, and keeps it applied after each chorded key until you lift your finger. Turn off only if your host misbehaves with sustained modifiers.
Hold modifier on target while chording
Hold key down on the target
Sends one key-down when you press and releases when you lift your finger. Better for games or apps that expect a real held key instead of repeated taps.
After a short delay, sends many quick press-and-release cycles—similar to auto-repeat when holding a physical key for typing.
Short tap sends that modifier key once to the target. Long-press a modifier, keep your finger down, then tap other keys to chord (e.g. long-press Shift and tap 1 for !). Release the modifier to stop.
Tap once to latch a modifier on; tap again to turn off. Highlighted keys show what is latched. Good for typing shifted symbols with a separate tap on Shift, then the key.
How fast content scrolls when you drag the strip beside the touchpad. Independent from General → touchpad two-finger scroll sensitivity.
Touchpad sub-mode in Keyboard & Mouse (Basic): the vertical strip at the right edge for page scroll.
Reset Rows 2–3 strip profile to factory layout
This restores the Default shortcut catalog (General tab) and Favorites to a fresh install. Other profiles are not changed.
Default caps: digits and symbols when local Fn is off; F-keys when local Fn is on. Columns are Base and Fn HID slots (not the latch).
Swapped those two keys (no shortcuts assigned). Factory caps in this list do not move—only assignments do.
Drop on another slot to swap assignments.

Same as the DISPLAY key at the end of row 1: how shortcuts on the strip look (names, icons, or combo text), and how Tab and the bottom-row modifier keys on the main keyboard look.
When on, letter keys show small long-press hint glyphs and support the alternates popup. When off, those keys use hold-to-repeat (gaming style).

Pad + mouse keys: move the pointer and two-finger scroll on the pad; use L, M, and R for clicks and drag (same hold-swipe-to-lock as Keyboard & Mouse Basic). Hybrid: full pad gestures plus the strip, with L/M/R flashing on pad taps and L held while you drag from the pad.
Show a drag strip beside the touchpad for mouse wheel up/down (same idea as Keyboard & Mouse Basic). Works in all touchpad modes, including Gestures only.
How fast content scrolls when you drag the strip. Independent from General → touchpad two-finger scroll sensitivity.

Same options as Keyboard & Mouse (Basic): sticky latch, or momentary tap with long-press to chord, plus hold then swipe up to lock on the host. Applies to Ctrl, Shift, Alt, and Win/Cmd on the QWERTY row and on the top shortcut strip.
When hints are off: letter keys
Same options as Keyboard & Mouse (Basic) setup: repeat taps while you hold, or one key-down until you lift your finger.
Catalog and favorites for row 1 use the selected profile. Manage profiles in Shortcut Hub.

List is best for browsing and editing. Card view uses larger type and a grid for quick access while you work.
How each shortcut shows in this profile’s Favorites and category tabs. Does not change the keyboard row‑1 strip; use Keyboard & Mouse Pro setup for that.
